name: Deva Ramanan
title: Professor
fitReason: Strong foundation-model-to-action match: recent work connects selective VLA finetuning, learning from actionless human demonstrations, and multimodal predictive robot policies. His wider group also studies perception and 3D reconstruction, so propose a specifically manipulation-focused project.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 2026 ModAR reports learned execution with bimanual YAM arms on cup stacking, towel folding and object placement/drawer closure, with 30 rollouts per task and method/data mixture. Ramanan is a coauthor in the all-CMU collaboration. Earlier Robotic Steering performs actual Franka Panda VLA rollouts across five manipulation tasks, rather than merely testing recorded robot data. Hardware access under his own supervision is not established.

shortVisit.summary: The current faculty page lists students and historical visitors, but no explicit external-master’s summer or short-term visitor invitation was verified. A current CMU master’s student identifies Ramanan as adviser; this demonstrates master’s supervision, not external summer eligibility.

unknowns: No Summer 2027 opening, eight-week agreement, remote arrangement, funding or mentoring capacity is confirmed. Historical visitors and current degree students are not a current visiting-student offer.

Keep physical evidence at 20: ModAR is a current CMU collaboration with Jeffrey Ichnowski; its first author explicitly names Ichnowski as adviser. The inspected sources do not allocate the apparatus or visitor access to Ramanan’s own group. Robotic Steering is a multi-institution collaboration.

ModAR uses discrete task identifiers, not open-ended language commands. Its human videos supervise future observations, while robot demonstrations provide action supervision. The frequently repeated 75% versus 72% comparison is simulation, not the three physical tasks.
Robotic Steering is restricted to one Franka embodiment. Its small-task few-shot findings do not establish general multi-embodiment performance.

Reuse the existing CMU Student Intern and Collaborating Visitor notes. The independent OIE route may accommodate degree students enrolled abroad with personal or external support, subject to host approval. RISS is not a master’s route; institutional policy does not supply a lab opening.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
